description.value: The Richmond Olympic Experience is North America's first Olympic Museum Network member, housed inside the Richmond Olympic Oval that hosted long-track speed skating during the 2010 Vancouver Winter Games. Spanning three levels with over 30 exhibits, it blends artifact galleries with hands-on physical challenges and 180° virtual sport simulators — including Olympic bobsleigh, whitewater kayak, and sit-ski. A touring cyclist can pause their ride to test stickhandling skills, view historic Olympic medals up close, and explore Canada's full sport story in one immersive stop.
